prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept / PIXEL ART VFX production source. Create ONLY original compact combat effects for the four approved arena creeps, matching attached character concepts and existing small contact-effect atlas. No characters, concepts, UI or maps. Exact TWENTY-EIGHT effects in a regular SEVEN ROW × FOUR COLUMN invisible grid, tall portrait canvas preferred1024x1792. One complete centered effect in each cell, generous true-transparent gutters. TRUE transparent alpha background, no checkerboard, floor, text, labels, borders, shadows or enormous glow clouds.
Crisp square pixel clusters, stepped dark-red/charcoal edges, limited orange/yellow/ivory/taupe material tones. Avoid blurry gradients and smooth vectors. Compact readable effects intended at about10–36 logical pixels beside a44px hero; do not create screen-filling explosions. Every row is one animation with FOUR distinct phases.
ROW1 Demon Hound contact: compact ivory fang/claw spark with crimson/orange embers. Seed contact, small sharp burst, short fading claw sparks, residual ember. No blood, no huge slash trail.
ROW2 Fire Imp impact: small yellow-core orange fire pop. Contact seed, tight little fire burst, broken contracting flame, tiny dying flecks.
ROW3 Fire Cultist impact: controlled darker-orange/amber flame blossom with bright yellow core and dark crimson edging. Seed, compact flame spike, folding flame curl, residual sparks. Visibly a little heavier than Imp but still small.
ROW4 Horned Demon Brute ground contact: LOW WIDE taupe dust and tiny stone/bronze impact flecks. Compact contact seed, heavier short dust fan, settling dust curl, sparse final dust. No expanding area ring, no ground-crack field, no map art or new ability telegraph.
ROW5 Fire Imp FIREBALL PROJECTILE loop: four small different flickering phases of SAME bright yellow/orange core with SHORT trailing flame toward LEFT; projectile nose points RIGHT in all4. Same position/scale and compact silhouette, no travel across cell.
ROW6 Fire Cultist FIRE PROJECTILE loop: four flicker phases of SAME slightly longer pointed orange flame bolt, bright yellow core, dark crimson outer pixel edging, tail to LEFT and nose RIGHT in all4. No character staff and no movement across cells.
ROW7 Demon Hound ember trail: four small handfuls of glowing crimson/orange/gold pixels, tiny seed sparks then lift/spread/fade. Each cell nonempty, few readable flecks near center, no smoke cloud or large flame.
All artwork complete inside each cell, enough transparent margin, no overlapping neighbors. These are visual assets only; no new mechanics or balancing implied. Match palette/material from supplied approved hound/imp/cultist/brute and compactness of actual existing contact atlas.
